assertionResults.fullName: AC-1: external effect intent is durable before dispatch, immutable and idempotent, and registration requires exact current task owner/fence
AC-2: unresolved daemon effects block expired-lease reclaim, successful worker verification and guardian requeue; unknown cleanup cannot grant another attempt
AC-3: only exact adapter/identity absent receipts release the fence; cleanup confirmation is idempotent and stale owners cannot create effects after reclaim
AC-4: unknown effects remain durably visible after blocked recovery, unrelated tasks retain native semantics, and no synthetic receipt claims live daemon cleanup or independent verification
